passage.label: An-Nisa — O believers believe in Allah Messenger Book sent to Messenger scripture before; whoever disbelieves Allah angels books messengers Last Day gone far astray; believed then disbelieved then believed then disbelieved increased disbelief Allah never forgive nor guide; glad tidings hypocrites painful punishment; take disbelievers allies instead believers seeking honor but honor belongs Allah entirely; revealed in Book when hear ayat denied mocked do not sit until different conversation otherwise like them; Allah gather hypocrites disbelievers Hell together; those wait watching if victory say were we not with you if disbelievers chance say did we not gain advantage protect from believers; Allah judges Day Resurrection never give disbelievers way over believers; hypocrites deceive Allah He deceives them; stand prayer lazily showing off remember little; wavering between neither these nor those; whom Allah sends astray never find way; believers righteous deeds gardens rivers flowing abiding forever promise truth who more truthful than Allah

arabicExcerpts.text: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ ءَامِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَٱلۡكِتَٰبِ ٱلَّذِي نَزَّلَ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِۦ وَٱلۡكِتَٰبِ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنزَلَ مِن قَبۡلُۚ وَمَن يَكۡفُرۡ بِٱللَّهِ وَمَلَـٰٓئِكَتِهِۦ وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَرُسُلِهِۦ وَٱلۡيَوۡمِ ٱلۡأٓخِرِ فَقَدۡ ضَلَّ ضَلَٰلَۢا بَعِيدًا
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ثُمَّ كَفَرُواْ ثُمَّ ءَامَنُواْ ثُمَّ كَفَرُواْ ثُمَّ ٱزۡدَادُواْ كُفۡرٗا لَّمۡ يَكُنِ ٱللَّهُ لِيَغۡفِرَ لَهُمۡ وَلَا لِيَهۡدِيَهُمۡ سَبِيلَۢا
بَشِّرِ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقِينَ بِأَنَّ لَهُمۡ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
ٱلَّذِينَ يَتَّخِذُونَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ أَوۡلِيَآءَ مِن دُونِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَۚ أَيَبۡتَغُونَ عِندَهُمُ ٱلۡعِزَّةَ فَإِنَّ ٱلۡعِزَّةَ لِلَّهِ جَمِيعٗا

وَقَدۡ نَزَّلَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ أَنۡ إِذَا سَمِعۡتُمۡ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ يُكۡفَرُ بِهَا وَيُسۡتَهۡزَأُ بِهَا فَلَا تَقۡعُدُواْ مَعَهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ يَخُوضُواْ فِي حَدِيثٍ غَيۡرِهِۦٓ إِنَّكُمۡ إِذٗا مِّثۡلُهُمۡۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ جَامِعُ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقِينَ وَٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ جَمِيعًا

ٱلَّذِينَ يَتَرَبَّصُونَ بِكُمۡ فَإِن كَانَ لَكُمۡ فَتۡحٞ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ قَالُوٓاْ أَلَمۡ نَكُن مَّعَكُمۡ وَإِن كَانَ لِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ نَصِيبٞ قَالُوٓاْ أَلَمۡ نَسۡتَحۡوِذۡ عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَنَمۡنَعۡكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَۚ فَٱللَّهُ يَحۡكُمُ بَيۡنَكُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۚ وَلَن يَجۡعَلَ ٱللَّهُ لِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ عَلَى ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ سَبِيلًا
إِنَّ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقِينَ يُخَٰدِعُونَ ٱللَّهَ وَهُوَ خَٰدِعُهُمۡ وَإِذَا قَامُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ قَامُواْ كُسَالَىٰ يُرَآءُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ وَلَا يَذۡكُرُونَ ٱللَّهَ إِلَّا قَلِيلٗا
مُّذَبۡذَبِينَ بَيۡنَ ذَٰلِكَ لَآ إِلَىٰ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَلَآ إِلَىٰ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِۚ وَمَن يُضۡلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَلَن تَجِدَ لَهُۥ سَبِيلٗا

mainSubject.label: Believe in Allah Messenger Book and prior scripture; disbelief in core articles equals far astray; repeated belief-disbelief cycle unforgivable; hypocrites face painful punishment; seeking honor through disbeliever alliances misplaced since all honor belongs to Allah; withdraw from ayat-mocking company or become like them; hypocrites and disbelievers gathered in Hell; opportunistic watchers claim allegiance to victors; Allah judges Resurrection Day never giving disbelievers way over believers; hypocrites deceive Allah but He deceives them; lazy showy prayer with minimal dhikr; wavering between neither group; no way for whom Allah misdirects

commandsAndProhibitions.description: Prohibition: do not sit with those denying and mocking Allah's ayat until they change topic.

socialEconomicCivilisational.label: Social boundary maintenance: withdrawal from sacrilege

notes: Pass A Nisa passage 15/16. Intensifies treatment of hypocrisy and belief boundaries. Six-article faith formula (4:136). Repeated apostasy distinguished from single lapse (4:137). Social hygiene protocol against sacrilegious company (4:140). Reciprocal deception concept unique to hypocrites (4:142). Existential diagnosis of muthabthabeen (wavering ones) as distinct category. Overlaps with scholarly topic 'hypocrisy'.
